detail.longDescription: I've been working on a # selfhosted # livestream web app and want to share it with you guys who might be interested. 🤓 Note that it's WIP. https:// nudlan.is - Video and chat ran in an # owncast instance. - Fully functioning interactions board. Got sound alerts, chat nameing and a weekly game request button. More to be added, it's a WIP. - Chat bubbles that feed straight into the video. For full screen and VoD viewerd to get chat context. # gaming # livestreaming # videogames # linuxgaming
